shortDescription: Information module for Field Notices Results Notices Id Network Devices

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Id of the field notice.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. Minimum value is 1. Maximum value is 500. Default value is 500.

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: NetworkDeviceId query parameter. Id of the network device.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1. Default value is 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values asc, desc. Default value is asc.

options.name: scanStatus
options.description: ScanStatus query parameter. Status of the scan on the network device. Available values NOT_SCANNED, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
